scripts.install:all: npm install --include=dev --prefix server && npm install --include=dev --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix client
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.start: npm run migrate:prod --prefix server && npm run start --prefix server
